# controld_rule_folder (Resource)

Manages a custom rule folder (group) within a ControlD profile. Rule folders let you group and bulk-manage custom rules under a single action.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "controld_rule_folder" "ads" {
  profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
  name       = "Ads & Trackers"
  do         = 0 # block
  status     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the rule folder. Changing this forces a new resource to be created, as the ControlD API does not support renaming a folder.
- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile this rule folder belongs to.

### Optional

- `do` (Number) The action applied to hostnames in this folder: `0` (block), `1` (bypass), `2` (spoof), or `3` (redirect). Only present in state once explicitly set; the API omits it entirely until then.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the rule folder is enabled.
- `via` (String) The destination IP/hostname used when `do` is `spoof` or `redirect`. Not readable back from the API.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule folder identifier (PK).
- `rules_count` (Number) The number of rules contained in this folder.
